messages.「引き裂かれた追憶」を7まで溜め、S3で味方を撃ち倒して、その代償に敵へ超火力の: A Pierce attacker who builds Torn Memory to 7, shoots down an ally with S3, and turns that sacrifice into a devastating hit against an enemy. Reliably killing the chosen ally is central to his plan.
messages.S3「対象調整射撃」: 戦闘開始時に追憶が7なら、メインターゲットに味方を優先指: **S3 — Target Readjustment Fire**: At Combat Start, having 7 Torn Memory prioritizes an ally as the main target, favoring the target with the lowest HP. Coin Ⅰ is Unbreakable and only damages the main target; if that target is an ally, this attack changes their Pierce resistance to Fatal. If Coin Ⅰ kills an ally, Coin Ⅱ, also Unbreakable, gains +30%/40% damage per Torn Memory, up to +210%/280%. After attacking, loses SP equal to Torn Memory × 2, up to 14. If he had 7 Torn Memory at Combat Start, consumes it all afterward; if the attack killed an ally under that condition, recovers 20 SP. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.引き裂かれた追憶(最大7): S1「隙把握」・S2「貫かん」・守備「前方支援」で: **Torn Memory (maximum 7)**: Gained through S1 See Through Defenses, S2 Punch Through, and defense Front Line Support. Each stack increases S1 and S2 damage. His always-active Volatilized Memory passive removes all stacks at Turn End, then grants the same amount next turn.
messages.呼吸回数の始動: S1は使用時に呼吸回数1/2増加、的中時に1増加。守備は的中時: **Starting Poise Count**: S1 gains 1/2 Poise Count on use and another 1 on hit. Defense gains 2 Poise Potency and 2 Count on hit. S2 gains Potency but does not increase Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「凶弾」(傲慢×6・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分の攻撃で味方を死: **Combat passive — Fell Bullet (6 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Killing an ally with his own attack grants Fell Bullet next turn. Torn Memory consumed by his Fell Bullet E.G.O is restored in the same amount next turn.
messages.序盤はS1と守備で呼吸回数を作りながら追憶を貯める。S2は呼吸回数を増やさないの: Early on, use S1 and defense to establish Poise Count while building Torn Memory. S2 does not add Count, so avoid opening with it on turn 1. At 7 Torn Memory, use S3 to shoot an ally. If Coin Ⅰ fails to kill them, Coin Ⅱ does not receive its enhanced damage bonus, so prepare a suitable target beforehand. A simple approach is to bring a low-level Identity into a slot vacated by a withdrawn ally and use them as the target. He is harder to use outside Chain Battles, where losing an ally is a lasting disadvantage. S3 at 6 or fewer Torn Memory, or S2 with accumulated Memory, can still provide some damage without the full setup.
